title: MW theory dream characters
content: Been going to MW more frequently lately...one of the things I've been doing is actively trying to converse with MW dream characters as a way to force myself to go more lucid within my dream. One new thing I realized is no one in MW is actually a stranger. If you talk to them...they recognize you. It's hard to explain really...like that feeling of "where do I know this person from". Kinda like a grown up version of a middle school friend that look has changed so drastically you might not immediately recognize them but you know their vibe. Possibly an "MW Avatar" Is this guy my boss in a furture/past/alternate lifetime? Shit like that. I used to think MW characters were just fabrications of my own mind so I talked with them to try to get to know myself better I dunno.....I now kinda think mallworld is the internet of the astroworld...sometimes I feel like im a different "Avator" like im always me but different versions of me....just a theory...what are you guys interactions with MW dream characters? Did they ever say shit you have no knowledge of like the info came not from you but someone else?
